newsitem.title: USA: US carlot pork primal cuts-hams -1500 CDT- Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: US carlot pork primal cuts-hams -1500 CDT- Oct 21.

text.p: Note: USDA Market News is working with the pork industry to revise U.S. pork price reporting to accommodate the new products that have affected price discovery.
A revised report is being developed with a format that more closely reflects the range of pork products being produced by and sold to processors, retailers and end users.
During the next few months a revised report will be developed one primal cut at a time, starting with hams. USDA hopes to have all primal cuts included by January 1, 1997.

The revised report will run simultaneously with the unchanged current report ("Central U.S. carlot pork -- USDA" on Reuter pages LNFD-E) for a minimum of one year to provide the pork industry and USDA time to analyze the reports.
Comments on the following primal ham section should be directed to Mike Erwin at USDA Market News (515-284-4460).
REPORTING CHANGES - The following changes will run concurrent ly with the existing pork report for comparison.
* NOTE: 3 muscle = Inside, Ouside, and Knuckle
4 muscle = Inside, Outside, Knuckle, and Lite Butt
5 muscle = Inside, Outside, Knckl, Lite Butt, & Inner Shank
ABCDE after quotes represents days since last actual market test. Quotes are dropped after 5 days of no test or before if they no longer reflect current market conditions.
